properties.site-address: Hospital Car Park, Preston Road, Chorley
properties.notes: The site has outline planning permission for 28 dwellings. It also has temporary planning permission for use a hospital car park until July 2019 therefore redevelopment of the site is unlikely until after this date. The outline planning permission has been renewed several times as well as the temporary planning permission for use as a car park. Given the uncertainty regarding the delivery of this site it has not been included in the five year supply.. Outline application for the erection of a 4 storey apartment building providing 28 No. one and two bedroom apartments with associated car parking, all matters reserved save for access, layout and scale
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
